title: Building the cosmic web
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: In standard cosmological models, dark matter contributes gravity that helps matter collect into the large-scale structures in which galaxies form. Observations test these models.

misconception: A learner may choose: It prevents all galaxies from forming
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: What role does dark matter play in standard models of structure formation?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: What role does dark matter play in standard models of structure formation? Its gravity helps structure grow. In standard cosmological models, dark matter contributes gravity that helps matter collect into the large-scale structures in which galaxies form. Observations test these models.
Visual caption: Gravity helps structure grow. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.
